name: coder-one-microluna-v7
note: microluna-v6's acceptance-suite loop, parallel and held to its evidence. The first edit session works while the suite is written and proven red on a snapshot of the untouched workspace; three writers split the requirements in one low-effort, one-pass round that rewrites only for hard, code-checked failures, find deciding facts by reading the code's documentation and probing its properties, count the standard definition of a method the task names as stated, keep green-at-start tests as guards, and expand a sweep over modules into a defect inventory. Red tests Jev reads as touching different files run as up to three sessions at once in workspace copies, merged back three ways, with a conflict requeued. Jev picks the move after each round, and the same failure twice stops the loop. A partial green gets a gap round, a green suite a joined closing judgment and, when it doubts, an audit session, then the task's own tests as a final guard. Sessions carry the current source in their cached prefix, read in parallel, and orient at low effort. Written for issues #9585 and #9588.
